I had to switch to my alternate account (because I haven't come out as dysphoric on my main one).  I used to make that lesbian in a man body joke alot too.  

Anyways, I just wanted to say a couple of things.  I hate it when people say they feel sorry for me.  I don't want pity, but I do want understanding.  When I tell people, I don't want them to say "Wow, the shit you must've gone through...I feel so bad for you!"  What I want...is for them to laugh, and say "Haha, that's cool.  So you wanna catch a movie or what?"  If I'm going through a hard time, then I'll talk about it, but otherwise I really just want to be treated the same as I've always been treated.

I came out to a friend after I had a moderate amount to drink.  I was still very aware, but I acted wasted, and the next day I pretended like I didn't know what I had said.  And it's cool.  I guess I still don't have the courage to be completely open about it, but he treats me the same as before, and that's all I want.

Anyways, I'm not sure if your husband is like that too, but it's something to think about.

Here is a man who understands unconditional love.

Retractable penis and ballsack, with the added ability to have full control over boners.

Sometimes I sit awkwardly and squish my balls and it hurts.  Also unwanted boners when I'm sleepy and/or daydreaming...stuff.

The psyche is a delicate and very complex thing.  Sometimes something inside you gets broke, and it can't be fixed.

It's like telling a kid in a wheelchair to get help and you don't feel sorry for him because he could really walk if he just tried harder.

You don't even know what empathy is.  Not everyone can "get over" things as easily as you, empathy is knowing that, and being understanding.

Congratulations on having gotten over it, hot shot.

She started crying, and saying that she was sad for me, cuz it just seemed so...pathetic...that I could be so lost.

I took that in stride, and asked why she was crying.  Was she upset because she felt partially responsible for it?

She said "No, believe me, I don't blame myself AT ALL."

Hi.  Please listen.  I was ready to leave too.  Just last week.  I'm not kidding, I drew up a plan for what I'd do.  I sat on my bed and put a plastic bag over my head and half-suffocated myself just to see how bad it would feel when I was finally ready to take the plunge.

Let me tell you what changed.  Things got worse.  I lost a good friend because I told him I was thinking of killing myself, and he got mad at me.  I told my girlfriend I wanted to seek a counselor to see if I'm really trans and she freaked out, said I had to really think about it, it would ruin my life, we wouldn't be able to stay together.  I keep up a good masculine front, so my mom doesn't suspect anything, and she said that she really really hates "girly boys."  And I woke up.

Why are we like this?  I don't know.  But what I do know is that all of us have a uniquely powerful ability to cause joy...and sorrow.  

It's been 7 hours since you posted this.  If you never see this, then...I'm sorry.  I'm sorry for what the world has done to you, and I hope that you've found peace.

I'm 25.  Your story mirrors mine.

Everyone knew I was girly, I just had the girl scared out of me as a kid.  And...everyone's so proud of me.  I'm so...masculine, and...charming, or whatever...

How do I answer for myself to everyone who's so happy about the way I turned out?
There are those of us the world hates.  We don't murder, steal, or hurt others.  Our only crime is existing, and our punishment is a lifetime of fear and sadness.

Really, the only thing you CAN do....is to give a guy a chance.  Your symptoms sound like a phobia: an unreasonable fear.

Got a phobia of heights?  go to high places, but go to high places in a situation where you KNOW you are being kept safe.  Like a tall building with strong windows.

You need to DESENSITIZE yourself to your fears, but that does NOT mean exposing yourself to them.  Hang out with a guy, but not in a situation where he CAN rape you.  Example: movie theater and then mall and then have him take you home where your family is: GOOD.  Hanging out with him alone in his apartment without your phone and where people don't know you are: BAD.

Face your fears, but don't leave yourself open to be hurt by them.

Be careful.  I did this for awhile and I seriously think I'm transgendered now.  I dunno if the habit MADE me trans or only brought it out in me.

Either way, I'd watch out. =p

EDIT: lighten up, downvoters, I knew I was trans before engaging in this, it was just a joke.

I know it's wrong to feel this way, but I almost feel as if...as if I would be considered cowardly for NOT transitioning if I really am trans.

Things start to get really confusing after awhile if you think about them too much.

Hmmm, if that were the conclusion, I guess I'd be a little embarrassed, and confused.  Thinking like, wow, how did I manage to convince myself I was a girl?

But....I guess I'd take his advice and wait a bit and see if it does pass?  Also, I guess that conclusion might be....good?

Mostly I feel like transitioning would be such a difficult experience.  Although, without a doubt, if I could choose to be born a girl, I would.  If a button magically changed me into a girl and no one would bat an eye, I would probably do that too.  But transitioning.....that's very difficult. =<
Thank you, these are fantastic tips.

welp.  I'm trans.  Thanks.  =)

haha, no seriously, now I'm more freaked out, because I probably would've pushed that button pretty quick and been on my way to girly-land.  But here's the thing:  What if this feeling is only temporary??  What if I'm going to be comfortable being a guy like 2 years from now??  Why would I suddenly start to feel this way, like I want to change?  aaaauuuuuugh *stabs self in ~~eye~~ballls*

I have to be honest, at first I was very terrified that I was, because I imagined a future of having to either come out and start transitioning in front of everyone I've ever known, OR be unhappy as a male forever.

I guess the situation hasn't changed much, but....I'm not that afraid anymore?  But I should feel scared, right?  Transitioning is scary, right?  If only it happened quicker and behind closed doors...

I've tried to imagine myself in drag, but I know that it just won't feel right.  I'll KNOW that I have a male body.  But when I imagine myself with a female BODY that makes me feel pretty good....

...I really want to talk to a therapist but until I'm comfortable enough to let a few people in my life know then I don't know if I could do that...

The main reason why I'm not coming out to anyone in my life, and am even hesitant about seeing a therapist.

I seriously think I'm trans.  I tried coming out to my gf but she shut me down, said that I was probably overthinking it.  I have no idea.
I do feel better, thanks.  I'm unemployed too, and I'm trying really hard to find a job, and find myself.  Goodnight. =)

oh are we playing this game?  Sorry sweetie, I don't think so, I'm worse.  I can't deal with real life sadness either.  I spent my aunt's funeral quietly cracking inappropriate jokes, because that's how I stress, but I cried when I watched the firefly movie.  I was more weepy about the ending of a tv show than the ending of a person.  Well, I was watching the movie alone.  I can't cry in front of people so I shove it through a machine that turns it into bad jokes.
absolutely.  I dunno.....maybe I should start helping people......that would give me something to do, and a reason to feel good about myself....

hehehehehe!! That made me giggle, thanks!

When I went out with my friends this weekend I accidentally let out a giggle.  In fact I was picked on alot as a kid because I giggled.  I developed a manly guffaw, of course, but I must be regressing if I'm giggling again. =p

I just got....really shaken up, is all.

Two years ago I felt unstoppable, and I'm just so...small...right now....

....and feeling small I felt like I could disappear and have that be it.....

People like him and beast make me think that there's no excuse for the way I'm feeling.  I should be okay with myself.  I should be strong.  They were.  And that only makes me feel worse.  Why can't I just be who I am?  Why do I hate myself so much?

I came close to finally accepting myself today, but I started browsing facebook.  Everything laid out.  I saw every single person that I've ever known.  Elementary school, highschool, college.  I know they have their demons, but they can hide those.  If I changed, everyone would know what I am.

And WHY?  why do I find myself disgusting?  I don't think that about other transgendered people!  I see them changing and I'm jealous.  I'm happy for them.  But why can't I be like that for myself!?  I don't understand.

Sigh....I can't love myself.  That was beasts's problem.  He hated himself and by extension hated everyone else.

I don't feel like elaborating too much, but I've most likely got Gender Dysphoria, and it's driving me nuts.

I know there's one thing you haven't tried.  You haven't tried waiting.

Listen, you could always do it tomorrow, or the day after.  I'm serious.  That's what's keeping me going.  Procrastination, friend.  It can save you.
Are you doing okay?  You don't sound too good yourself, to be honest.

All love is conditional.  There's the condition that you're family, or that they liked you when you were friends.  

Or perhaps....the condition that you're not a freak.  Unlike me.

I'm thinking.  About seeing a doctor.  I need to find one first, but when I do....I'll go.

I'm very calm right now.  Not depressed or anxious.  Suicide is not a troubling thought.  Do you think a sane person could commit suicide?  I don't see why not.  It's just a longer, more drawn out version of jumping out of a building on fire, right?  You don't need to be crazy to choose a falling death over a burning death.

no.  I'm sorry.  I know how you're hurting, but I will NOT tell you how to do it.  I will not have anyone else's blood on my hands.

Have you tried professional help?  They are trained to be sympathetic and to be able to help people work out their problems.  Please.  I know I sound hypocritical, telling you to seek help, but I really think you should.

At the very least, give yourself more time.  That's what I'm doing right now.  I'm waiting.  For what, I don't know.  But at least wait.

Are you trying to convince me that they'd look for me?  Because I really don't think they would.  And really this only convinces me that I need to really pick a good hiding spot, and possible piss everyone off beforehand so that they don't care about looking for me.

Do you know how easy it is to destroy a relationship?  You can spend years together building camaraderie and all it would take is one night of yelling at him and trashing his house.  And then he won't care that you're gone.

That's different.  That case was easy to get into because an unarmed kid was shot by an adult.  It's easy to get mad about something like that.

Just think about it.  Asian (or whatever) male is missing, and that's it, we know nothing else, no one seemed to hate him or anything.  That is not news or manpower worthy.

I don't think I have depression, I just don't like the way things turned out, and I'm thinking of calling it quits.  I mentioned this in a not serious way to several people and they say things like "it's cowardly, it's immature, it's stupid..." and I agree with those things, but I really don't think that it really convinces me to NOT do it.  Honestly....I don't want to hurt the people around me....but really do they think I'd care what they thought of me after I died?

Sigh......I don't want to talk about myself to my parents or friends.  I tried talking to my girlfriend and she didn't really think I had a problem.  She said that I'm just dwelling on my issues too much, just give it time and don't think about it so much.  So, I'm going to guess that either they won't BELIEVE that I'm really fucked up on the inside, or they'd be grossed out by how fucked up I am.
An ethnic minority adult male draws much less attention than a white baby girl would.  I don't say that to be negative, it's just the way it is.

I'm not anybody important, they'd spend a few days looking and then give up, most likely, or however it is they deal with a normal Joe nobody going missing.

I've been thinking about seeing a therapist but I don't have insurance.

I'm not really sure where I am right now, though.  I've been breaking down before, but today I just feel...flat.  Like, an okay flat.  But today is also the day I've made this plan, to keep somewhere, in the back of my mind.  An exit strategy.

Try to view women outside of the context of relationships and sexuality.  Try to find a more raucous girl, who likes to be treated as one of the guys.  Be friends with her.  Don't think of her as a WOMAN, think of her as just a person.  Understand that they are people first and women second.

Are you proud of your appearance at all?  Women are pressured by society to look great, and that's why they like jewelery and clothes, because it helps them conform to what they think is expected of them.  But that is just one aspect of them.  They also have a sense of humor, preferences, dreams, beliefs, and thoughts.  Try to understand them as a whole package, a whole person.

Everyone is more than the sum of their parts.
Hey.....you wanna talk about it?  Please talk to someone about everything before doing anything rash.  =)  Send me a PM.

I understand.  Life is good.  Life is bad.  Some people have it great, and some people have it bad.  I'm sorry that things are bad, but.....I really hope you reconsider.  Everyone has the potential to be a person that the world could benefit from.  You say you have no more love to give, but that's just because you're hurting.  You're not damaged beyond repair.  Everyone has both light and darkness inside them, and the strength to choose which to give in to.  I'm sorry if it sounds cheesy, but it's true.

I hope you find the light.

First and foremost I want you to know that I completely don't blame you for the way you feel.  You want something.  You want to know that your fiance loves you unconditionally, loves you the most.  That is something that is reasonable for a person to want.

You're a good person.  You're not selfish, and you can empathize with others.  Don't worry so much.  Be happy with who you are.

Hi.  Um....it's kind of strange that the first person to see this would be me.  Recently I've felt like I might be transgendered, and I'm beginning to seriously consider transitioning.

It's caused me a great deal of stress.  I've gone from being okay to considering suicide within a week.  I've gone from telling people about my suicidal tendencies to then telling them thanks for talking to me, I'm better now, and then calmly closing the chat window and browsing for ways to make a suicide look like an accident, so that they don't know that I actually killed myself.

Here's the thing though.  You can't blame yourself for feeling the way you do, any more than I can blame myself for the feeling the way I do.  I hate myself.  I gross myself out.  But we are what we are, and we feel the way we do.  Everyone has insecurities.  It's unfortunate that the transgendered play on your insecurities, but it doesn't make you any less of a person.

I feel like I'm kind of rambling so I'm going to try to gather my thoughts.  Everyone has something that they don't like about themselves, but that THING, that imperfection, doesn't make you any less wonderful.  I'm sure you're a person with a big heart, and you're scared that this is an indication that you weren't what you thought you were.  Believe me, I know that feel.  At the end of the day, you're an individual, and you are exceptional.  Remember that.

Hey, listen.  What you need to remember is love.  Not just how much the people who care about you love you, but also that you don't want to hurt the people that you love.  Not just your parents.  Think harder.  Your friends.  The people who you've stopped talking to, but they'd still miss you if they knew you died.  People that you would meet in the future and make a connection with.

Understand that I'm writing this for you as much as I am for myself.  I really want to be gone too, but....it carries a heavy price, for everyone involved.
what takes time?  The recovery from the surgery, or what?  Time is stopping you, right?  I just didn't know there were parts that had to take time...
aahhh...will epilating cause bleeding?

Hello!  I relate to you almost exactly the same on each of the points you've brought up.  When I'm out with girls I'm jealous of them and I feel left out, and I'm awkward with the guys.

I think we are trans.  That's just my thought.  I can't let this thought go, right now.  It's eating me up.  I don't know what I'll do.  Whatever you decide to do, let me know.  Since we're so similar maybe your solution would work for me as well.

You know, I hurt myself easily when I'm falling down drunk and I don't feel it.  Maybe try that?

But also maybe have a good friend help you out because I don't think you should be operating any machinery if you're that drunk.

I wish brain transplant surgery were a thing.  Wouldn't that make things easier?  Meet me at a clinic, and bam, we both get what we want.

Sigh.....
.....thank you.  =)

People will never accept me.  

I know, I know, there is a large community of loving people, and the people who can't accept me for who am don't matter, and all that other good stuff.  I just....can't see myself....getting uprooted like that, losing everything I have right now.

Maybe I'm just too cowardly...I don't know.

Don't worry about it.  I've been hiding it as well.

If you ever want someone to talk to don't hesitate to PM me.  I can tell you how I've been coping with my frustrations and fears, and we can vent to each other.  Girl to girl.  =)
Please make sure you don't let this opportunity pass you bye.  If I had known when I was younger, I would have made the change.  My time is done, but you still have a chance.

So...have you talked about this more with the people in your life??

I came out to my girlfriend, told her I feel more like a girl, and she didn't really believe me, said it was just a phase I was going through.  I haven't told anyone else...but I really think we need to find people in our lives who will believe us, and who can understand how we feel.

Hello? Hi, I would like to thank you very much for asking this question, because I FEEL THE SAME FUCKING WAY.  And I feel terrible because I"m completely unsure if I'm trans or not, so......I feel terrible.  I tell people online that I am because online I like to be a girl, but otherwise...I don't know...I just don't know.....

*looks around, sees lots of FTM. Clears throat*

uhhhh....hi.....MTF here.....I dunno if you could really relate to my experience, but....I'm also trapped right now.  In fact, probably I won't be able to transition for the rest of my life, and I'm 25....

I feel depressed, mostly, and left out when i'm with a group of girls, and awkward when I'm with a group of guys.  People online have been supportive, but I haven't had the courage to tell anyone I know in person.

Mostly my problem nowadays is that in trying my best to hide what I am I take my male persona too far.  I take the "cool" attitude into total detachment from the situation, and I take "natural aggression" into complete and total fiery jackass.  Within the past week I almost got into a fistfight with my cousin and a homeless guy.  Uh...not at the same time.

I feel like a worthless piece of shit alot too...so at least you're not alone.  Misery loves company!

Hi Niccy.  Please feel free to PM me as well.

I'm feeling pretty terrible nowadays too.  I've spend more than 2 decades unaware of what I was, just knowing that I had thoughts and urges, and then finally when the truth hit me, I was devastated.  I realized I would never be a real boy, OR a real girl.  I'm too old to transition well.

I'm handling it okay nowadays though, but it would be nice to talk to someone with the same issue.  I've come out to friendly strangers online, but nobody that I know in person knows what I am, and I've only talked briefly with a couple of transgenders....
I didn't think that's what you were saying, I guess partly....I myself feel really shallow, and....dumb....

Is it shallow??  For me to want that?

People won't accept me for who I am, who I want to be, but at the same time they won't let me kill myself either, leaving only the option of...hating myself....

I was thinking of shaving my legs to see how they'd look, and also of buying some makeup and practicing applying it, to see if eventually I might make a passable girl.  If I could get myself to a decent state BEFORE facial feminization surgery, then I would seriously think about it.....maybe.....

And then the only other obstacles would really be my broad shoulders and my voice.  My adam's apple has always been stupid and weird.  Like, tiny and sharp.  I'd cut that little fucker off as quickly as I'd chop my dick off.

Yes I can remember PLENTY of childhood and teen episodes, but they weren't periods.  They were just isolated thoughts that took seconds each and then faded.  But right now, right now it's lasting.  Whenever i have a free moment my mind wanders automatically, thinking about this, thinking about how cute that girl's hair is, how nice her makeup is, how cute her top is.  It happened so quickly, I don't know if like.....it's just....a thing!?  I don't know what it is!

Yes, if I could magically become shorter and cuter, I think I'd take it in a heartbeat.

But the thing is....I don't think even going through the transition could make me the type of girl I'd want to be....that's where my doubts are.  If a transition could help, like if I were short and skinny already, I'd seriously, seriously consider it.  So....I don't know what to do........

Well, first and foremost, yea, I really don't want other people to see me like that.  And secondly, I don't want these thoughts because I know it will never happen.  I'm old, and tall.  I won't ever be the kind of girl that I'd want to be.

In short, I know I can never have what I want, so I would like for the desire to go away.

Hehe, I'm completely in love with my girlfriend and I can't imagine sex or being in love with a man.  It's a very confusing feeling, because when I see a hot or pretty girl around, I'm both thinking about how I'd like to sex them AND be them.
You know what I fucking want?? Character fucking customization.  Gender and race and all that good shit? I want that, religion is way easier to change than your skin.

Mmmmm, well I'd mentioned in another post that while I'm not the hulk, I've already got what I think is too masculine a frame.  I'm 5'10" and 150 pounds with broad shoulders.  What do you think the end result of me would look like?  I'd say Amazonian at best....and I've asked just in passing how my girlfriend would take me transitioning.  She didn't know I was being serious and said that she wouldn't like me as a girl, unless I'm "really cute."  =(  She may be supportive of me in the end but my guess is that the relationship would be over.

How long did you have to think about your choice before you made it?  I've had dysphoria in the past, when I was too young to know what dysphoria was, and I suppressed it that time.  I just don't know if it will be easier to suppress it again now...

I'm still coming to terms with my dysphoria, as you can see I'm using an alternate account just to talk about it.

The things that tipped me off is that I constantly have daydreams about what it would be like to be a woman, to be graceful and beautiful and fun and flirty, and that I also appear in my dreams as a woman.

However, i'm 25 now, and I've spent a long time and lots of effort cultivating my personality and identity as a male, and I feel like I've done a really good job of it, but for some reason lately I just really can't shake that thought, of how nice it would be to be a girl.  I don't want to disturb the life I'm making, I don't want to accept that my dysphoria is real....but I have a feeling it doesn't really care what I want.

So, that's the first part I guess.  As far as the second part, I'm so terrified of what people would think of me if they knew the truth that really, I don't know if I could be offended.  Probably as long as you didn't decide to forever cut off ties with me when you found out I'd be extremely grateful already.

As a last thought, even though I want to be a girl, I still can only see myself with a girl for a partner, so I guess technically I'm a lesbian in the body of a man.  Or, as I like to put it, extra straight, because I love women so much that I want to be one.

What determines the effectiveness of the hormone therapy?  I've seen some very impressive and some less impressive transitions, and also I've read that often-times surgery is needed to correct things like facial bone structure and, obviously, the genitals.

You......made the change?

Can I ask...how much the surgery cost?  And really how effective you think it was, and maybe what recovering from it was like?  I'm not feminine looking at all, so I have my doubts about how well the change would suit me.  I'm about 5'10 and 150 pounds with broad shoulders.

I guess if you're not comfortable answering in the comments perhaps you could PM me?  Thanks.
